title: The Global T20 Nomad: F du Plessis's Journey Across 9 Leagues
summary: F du Plessis has played in 9 T20 leagues (BBL, BPL, CPL, IPL, MLC), scoring 10199 runs at 34.3.
body:
## 9 Leagues, One Mission

F du Plessis is one of T20 cricket's true globetrotters. From the IPL to the BBL, from the CPL to the PSL, he's plied his trade across **9 different T20 leagues**: BBL, BPL, CPL, IPL, MLC, NPL, PSL, SA20, T20I.

**Career Numbers:** 10199 runs | 325 innings | Avg 34.3 | SR 139.4

That kind of cross-league experience shapes a player. Different pitches, different pressure, different tactical demands — and Plessis has delivered across all of them.

---
*Data across 9 T20 leagues. Analysis by MatchPrism.*
